facts.text: The hotel sits between mountains, forest and the St. Lawrence River in Charlevoix.
facts.excerpt: Nestled between mountains, forest, and the St. Lawrence River in Charlevoix

facts.text: The hotel was built in the late 19th century in French-chateau style.
facts.excerpt: Built in the late 19th century in French-chateau style

facts.text: The hotel is about 90 minutes from Quebec City.
facts.excerpt: all just 90 minutes from Quebec City

facts.text: The golf course has 27 holes, carved into rolling hills with views of the St. Lawrence River.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a 27-hole course carved into rolling hills, with stunning views of the St. Lawrence River.

facts.text: Moment Spa sits on the banks of the St. Lawrence River and offers massages, facials and body treatments.
facts.excerpt: the hotel features Moment Spa, a tranquil retreat on the banks of the St. Lawrence River, offering high-end massages, facials, and body treatments.

facts.text: Guests have access to the Multi-Sports Centre, with indoor and outdoor pools, steam rooms and an exercise room.
facts.excerpt: Guests also have access to the Multi-Sports Centre, with indoor and outdoor pools, steam rooms, and an exercise room

facts.text: Dining includes gourmet meals at Le Saint-Laurent and family-friendly options at Le Bellerive.
facts.excerpt: gourmet meals at Le Saint-Laurent to family-friendly options at Le Bellerive

facts.text: In season, Le Point Cardinal serves a scenic brunch by the golf course.
facts.excerpt: In season, Le Point Cardinal serves a scenic brunch by the golf course.

facts.text: Family activities run year-round, from hiking and mini-golf in summer to ice skating and snowshoeing in winter.
facts.excerpt: from hiking and mini-golf in summer to ice skating and snowshoeing in winter

facts.text: Winter activities include snowshoeing, ice skating, ice fishing and winter via ferrata.
facts.excerpt: Snowshoeing, ice skating, ice fishing, winter via ferrata and so much more

facts.text: The Deluxe View Jacuzzi King room has a king bed, a St. Lawrence River view and a large Jacuzzi.
facts.excerpt: One King bed, St-Lawrence River view. Open concept inviting room featuring a large Jacuzzi.

facts.text: A casino is located right next door to the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Located right next door to Fairmont Le Manoir Richelieu, come try your luck!

facts.text: Check-in is from 4:00 pm and check-out is by 11:00 am.
facts.excerpt: Check-in time is from 4:00 pm, and check-out is by 11:00 am.
